name: Phi Yen memorial
summary: National intangible heritage, held on the 17th and 18th of the 10th lunar month at An Sơn miếu. The ministry article of 26 August 2023 describes an offering for calm weather and safety, then a fair: fruit trays, flower arranging, folk games, calligraphy, and đàn ca tài tử. Solar dates move. Check on arrival. Nghinh Ông at Thắng Tam and Dinh Cô at Long Hải are not Côn Đảo rites.
when: 17–18 of the 10th lunar month at An Sơn miếu. Solar dates move. Check on arrival.
